description: Branch R-FMT-1 FMT1-CALCULATED and R-FMT-2 Calculated wrappers: recomputation and dependency (public side), with expressions the first card showed ACE admits. On an ACCDB, CD(ID Long, A Long, B Text(20), C Text(255) = [B] & "-calc", N Long = [A] * 2) made through CreateTableDef; row (1, 5, 'x') inserted and read. One change at a time, each followed by a read of every column: A = 6; B = 'y'; B = Null; A = Null; A = 7 again; an UPDATE that sets C directly; a recordset Edit that sets N then Update (refused?) with CancelUpdate; ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN A (N depends on it). A second table CD2 of the same shape: the input A renamed through Field.Name; N's Expression put to [A2] * 3 on the existing field; ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN C (a calculated column itself). Asks when a stored result is recomputed, whether a calculated column can be written, and what dropping or renaming an input does.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
